heart: Hi! Welcome to Hallway twenty four! I'm Heart, your host, and I'm so happy you're here. Stay with me for twenty four hours. Every hour, you pick a door!
lewis: Good evening, and welcome to Hallway twenty four. I'm Lewis, your host. The rules are simple. Stay for twenty four hours. Every hour, you choose a door.

heart: Listen first, okay? Every door makes a little sound. Bells, keys and dishes are nice rooms. Dripping, buzzing and scratching are… less nice.
lewis: Before you choose, listen. Each door makes a sound. Bells, keys and dishes are usually lovely. Dripping, buzzing and scratching… usually are not.

heart: Pick left or right. You can listen again anytime. If something finds you, I'll tell you what to do, one time, so listen carefully! You've got this. Probably.
lewis: Choose the left door or the right door. Listen again whenever you like. If something finds you, I'll tell you what to do. Once. Do try to keep up.

heart: You have three hearts. If you lose them all, you stay here forever! With me! Okay, here we go!
lewis: You have three hearts. Lose them all and the hallway keeps you. Now then. Let us begin.

heart: You're back! I knew you'd come back. Nobody ever really leaves. Let's keep going!
lewis: Ah. You came back. Of course you did. Let's continue.

heart: A brand new night! I moved all the doors around for you!
lewis: A fresh start. The hallway has been rearranged.

heart: Hour one!
lewis: Hour one.

heart: Hour two!
lewis: Hour two.

heart: Hour three!
lewis: Hour three.

heart: Hour four!
lewis: Hour four.

heart: Hour five!
lewis: Hour five.

heart: Hour six! A quarter done! I'm so proud of you!
lewis: Hour six. A quarter of the way. Not bad.

heart: Hour seven!
lewis: Hour seven.

heart: Hour eight!
lewis: Hour eight.

heart: Hour nine!
lewis: Hour nine.

heart: Hour ten!
lewis: Hour ten.

heart: Hour eleven!
lewis: Hour eleven.

heart: Hour twelve! Halfway! Most people never get this far. You're special.
lewis: Hour twelve. Halfway. Most guests don't see this hour.

heart: Hour thirteen!
lewis: Hour thirteen.

heart: Hour fourteen!
lewis: Hour fourteen.

heart: Hour fifteen!
lewis: Hour fifteen.

heart: Hour sixteen!
lewis: Hour sixteen.

heart: Hour seventeen!
lewis: Hour seventeen.

heart: Hour eighteen! The hallway is getting hungry. Don't worry. It's not hungry for me.
lewis: Hour eighteen. The hallway is getting… hungry.

heart: Hour nineteen!
lewis: Hour nineteen.

heart: Hour twenty!
lewis: Hour twenty.

heart: Hour twenty one!
lewis: Hour twenty one.

heart: Hour twenty two!
lewis: Hour twenty two.

heart: Hour twenty three! Just one more after this. Please don't go. Just kidding! Unless?
lewis: Hour twenty three. One more after this. I almost don't want you to go.

heart: Hour twenty four! The very last door! Oh, I'm going to miss you.
lewis: Hour twenty four. The last door. Make it count.

heart: Two doors! Listen closely.
lewis: Two doors. Listen.

heart: Left or right? Listen!
lewis: Left, or right. Listen carefully.

heart: Ooh, I love these doors. Listen.
lewis: Here are your doors.

heart: Shh. Listen to what's behind them.
lewis: Pay attention to what's behind them.

heart: More doors! There are always more doors.
lewis: Two more doors. They never end, you know.

heart: Listen, then pick wisely! Or don't. It's more fun for me.
lewis: Listen. And choose wisely.

heart: Pick the left door or the right door. Or listen again!
lewis: Choose the left door or the right door. Or listen again.

heart: In you go!
lewis: In you go.

heart: Ooh, brave!
lewis: Bold choice.

heart: Let's see, let's see!
lewis: Let's see.

heart: Oh, interesting!
lewis: Hmm. Interesting.

heart: A cozy bedroom! Take a nap. You get a heart back!
lewis: A bedroom. Have a rest. One heart back.

heart: A soft little bed! Rest a bit. All better!
lewis: A soft bed. Lie down for a moment. You feel better.

heart: A bedroom! But you're already feeling great. Aww.
lewis: A bedroom, but you're already rested. A shame to waste it.

heart: A kitchen! There's a bandage in the drawer. It's yours!
lewis: A kitchen. There's a bandage in the drawer. Take it.

heart: The kitchen! Something smells, um, interesting. Here, a bandage!
lewis: The kitchen. Something's cooking. Never mind what. There's a bandage by the sink.

heart: The vault! Shiny tokens! Spend them in my shop!
lewis: The vault. Tokens. Spend them in my shop.

heart: Tokens everywhere! Grab them! I won't tell.
lewis: Tokens on the floor. Nobody will miss them. Probably.

heart: A storage closet! Ooh, you found something!
lewis: A storage closet. You find something useful.

heart: Lots of old boxes. And one of them has a present for you!
lewis: Boxes. Old boxes. And in one of them, something for you.

heart: An empty room! Nothing happens. Isn't that nice?
lewis: An empty room. Nothing happens. Enjoy it.

heart: Nothing in here! Just a chair facing the wall. Don't worry about the chair.
lewis: Nothing here. Just a chair. Facing the wall. Don't ask.

heart: So quiet! Too quiet? No, it's fine!
lewis: Empty. Quiet. Suspiciously quiet.

heart: A lighter!
lewis: A lighter.

heart: A bandage!
lewis: A bandage.

heart: A lucky charm! Lucky, lucky you!
lewis: A lucky charm. Lucky you.

heart: Two tokens!
lewis: Two tokens.

heart: Three tokens!
lewis: Three tokens.

heart: One token! Every token counts!
lewis: One token. Don't spend it all at once.

heart: You flick the lighter and peek under the left door. There's
lewis: You light the lighter and peek under the left door. Behind it:

heart: And under the right door, there's
lewis: And under the right door:

heart: No lighter! You can buy one in my shop!
lewis: You don't have a lighter. My shop sells them.

heart: a bed!
lewis: a bed.

heart: a kitchen!
lewis: a kitchen.

heart: something shiny!
lewis: something shiny.

heart: some boxes!
lewis: boxes.

heart: nothing at all!
lewis: nothing at all.

heart: a big puddle. It's growing!
lewis: a puddle. Growing.

heart: sparks! Zappy!
lewis: sparks.

heart: scratch marks. Lots of them.
lewis: scratch marks.

heart: someone sitting very, very still.
lewis: someone sitting very still.

heart: something pretending to be a room. Sneaky!
lewis: something pretending to be a room.

heart: Uh oh, it's the Drip! Wait for the big splash, then swipe down to hide in the locker. Not too early!
lewis: Oh dear. The Drip. When the dripping speeds up and you hear the splash, swipe down to hide in the locker. Not before the splash.

heart: It's Static! When you hear a buzz on one side, swipe the other way! Away from it! It keeps coming back!
lewis: Static. A buzz will come from one side. Swipe the other way. Away from it. Several times.

heart: The Crawler! If it growls, swipe up and run! If it sniffs, freeze! Don't run too early!
lewis: The Crawler. Listen to the steps. If it growls, swipe up and run. If it sniffs, don't move at all. Don't run early.

heart: It's the Counter! It counts down. Don't touch anything until it sighs and goes away. Nothing! Not even a little tap!
lewis: The Counter. It counts to zero. Don't touch anything until it sighs and leaves. Nothing at all.

heart: The Mimic! Two voices, left and right. The lower one is the Mimic. Swipe toward the real one! Tap to hear them again.
lewis: The Mimic. You'll hear two voices, left and right. The lower one is the Mimic. Swipe toward the real one. Tap to hear them again.

heart: The Drip! Wait for the splash!
lewis: The Drip. Wait for the splash.

heart: Static! Swipe away from the buzz!
lewis: Static. Swipe away from the buzz.

heart: The Crawler! Growl, run. Sniff, freeze!
lewis: The Crawler. Growl means run. Sniff means freeze.

heart: The Counter! Freeze!
lewis: The Counter. Don't move.

heart: The Mimic! Find the real voice!
lewis: The Mimic. Find the real voice.

heart: Oops, too early! It heard the locker.
lewis: Too early. It heard the locker door.

heart: Too slow! It found you.
lewis: Too late. It found you.

heart: Zap! Away from the buzz, remember?
lewis: The static got you. Away from the buzz, remember.

heart: You ran too early! It chased you!
lewis: You ran too soon. It chased you.

heart: It growled! That means run!
lewis: It growled. You should have run.

heart: You moved! It heard you!
lewis: You moved. It heard you.

heart: You moved! The Counter hates that.
lewis: You moved. The Counter doesn't like that.

heart: Wrong one! That was the Mimic!
lewis: Wrong voice. That was the Mimic.

heart: You did it! I'm so proud!
lewis: You survived. Well done.

heart: Still alive! Yay!
lewis: Still alive. Impressive.

heart: It's gone! Bye bye!
lewis: It's gone. For now.

heart: Amazing! You're amazing!
lewis: Nicely done. Truly.

heart: You're so much better than the last guest!
lewis: Hm. You're better at this than the last one.

heart: Two hearts left! It's okay!
lewis: Two hearts left.

heart: Only one heart left! Be careful, okay?
lewis: One heart left. Do be careful.

heart: Your lucky charm broke instead of you! Lucky!
lewis: Your lucky charm breaks instead of you. Lucky.

heart: Oh no! You're out of hearts. That means you stay here with me. Forever! Yay!
lewis: And that's the end of you. Don't worry. The hallway will keep you safe. Forever.

heart: No more hearts! Aww. Don't worry, I'll find a nice room for you.
lewis: Out of hearts. A pity. You were doing so well. Well, you were doing.

heart: You did it! Twenty four hours! The sun is up! You can go home! Come back soon, okay? Okay?
lewis: Twenty four hours. You actually did it. The sun is coming up. You may leave. This time.

heart: It's morning! You survived the whole night! I'm so proud I could cry!
lewis: Dawn. You survived the night. I'm almost proud. Almost.

heart: Welcome to my shop! Spend your tokens on something nice!
lewis: Welcome to my little shop. Spend your tokens. Then back to the hallway.

heart: Shop time! Everything's on sale! Not really, but it feels nice to say.
lewis: The shop is open. Prices are fair. Mostly.

heart: Great choice!
lewis: Excellent choice.

heart: Ooh, good pick!
lewis: A wise purchase.

heart: Not enough tokens! Sorry!
lewis: You can't afford that.

heart: Bye for now! The hallway missed you!
lewis: Off you go, then. The hallway is waiting.

heart: Bandage on! One heart back!
lewis: You wrap the bandage. One heart back.

heart: You're not hurt! Save it for later!
lewis: You're not hurt. Save it.

heart: You don't have a bandage!
lewis: You don't have a bandage.

heart: Did you hear that? No? Okay, good!
lewis: Did you hear that? No? Good.

heart: The last guest picked left a lot! Just saying!
lewis: The last guest picked left a lot. Just saying.

heart: I love spending time with you!
lewis: I do enjoy our time together.

heart: Ignore the scratching! The walls do that sometimes.
lewis: Don't mind the scratching. It's the walls. They do that.

heart: You're so brave! Or so lost! Either way!
lewis: You're very brave. Or very lost.

heart: I moved some doors around. For fun!
lewis: I've rearranged a few doors. For fun.

heart: Nobody's made it this far in ages. I'm getting nervous. For you!
lewis: You know, nobody's made it this far in a while.

heart: The doors are getting louder! Did you notice?
lewis: The doors are getting louder. Have you noticed?

heart: You don't really want to leave in the morning, do you?
lewis: Must you really leave in the morning?
